nodes.title: cancel
nodes.description: Add idempotent cancellation with refunds. API.cancel(owner, order_id, key) returns (status, body). Successful cancellation returns 200 and {id, state, refunded}; refunded is integer cents. Only paid orders can be cancelled; shipped orders return 409. Unknown or foreign orders return 404. Empty or non-string keys return 400. A key is scoped to owner: replay on the same order returns the original success without a second refund; reuse for a different order returns 409, even if that order is unknown. Failed requests must not reserve a key. A different key on an already cancelled order returns 409. Store refunds must be observable in store.refunds as (order_id, cents) tuples and persist across API instances sharing a Store. Client.cancel(order_id, key) returns the success body or raises ValueError(status). Existing get behavior remains unchanged. No external I/O or services.
